result.content:
Complete this browser application: Distance Lab. Convert kilometers into meters and miles.
Read README.md, index.html, app.js, and logic.js. Find and repair the calculation defect in logic.js. Keep the existing accessible form and local-only behavior. Numeric inputs must be finite and respect the labels; reject invalid input with a useful error. Use the example and project contract in TASK.md. Run the configured browser tests and finish only after seeing their result.

Example input/output:
[[{"kilometers": "5"}, {"meters": 5000, "miles": 3.11}]]

kilometers >=0. meters = kilometers*1000. miles = kilometers/1.609344. Round to 2 decimals.

# Distance Lab

Convert kilometers into meters and miles.

Open index.html in a browser or serve this directory with a local static server. No build, dependencies, accounts, or external assets. Data stays on this device.

The form validates inputs, calculates a result, supports reset, and saves only the last result; Clear saved result removes it. Includes keyboard focus and a mobile layout.
